text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The summer training camp to hone their 
skills begins once again this year.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Already in your gym clothes? You're quite 
fired up today~.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
This summer, I'm gonna become the 
strongest!! So Rogo—just wait and see what 
I do at the Kikuka Sho!

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
...Huh, didn't I tell you? I'm not running 
in the Kikuka Sho.

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
Excuse me~. I was just wondering if maybe 
there's a path better suited for me...

text_block_list.name: Logotype
text_block_list.text:
"Well, as long as we keep running, we'll 
get to compete again somewhere. Let's both 
do our best."

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ...So cool!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Logotype isn't here... Which means in the 
Kikuka Sho, the highest expectations will 
likely fall on Epiphaneia.
choice_data_list:
(Now I really can't afford to lose! For 
that, I need to...)

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Good morning. I look forward to working 
with you today.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: I'm looking forward to working with you!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
So you're Epiphaneia? What an energetic 
child.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, what wonderful muscles you have. 
Even among the top athletes I know, hardly 
anyone comes close to this...
choice_data_list: Yes, she's a really powerful girl.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"The voice of destiny always cheers me on 
so enthusiastically when I do strength 
training! So I've got total confidence in 
my power!"

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Fufu, then regarding that strength you're 
so proud of... Let's do a motion analysis. 
I brought the equipment, so let's take a 
look right away.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Ugh, it's so ticklish! Are you still 
slapping more of that on me?!"

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
I attached motion capture markers to 
Epiphaneia. First, we'll use motion 
capture to record her movements in 3D 
space with high precision.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Haaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Whoa...! I've watched footage before, 
but... Seeing it in person is on another 
level...!
choice_data_list: Yes, Umamusume races are truly intense!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
We have her run with motion markers 
attached, run the captured data through 
motion analysis software, and then Sensei 
analyzes it with a professional eye—

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
...Yes, please remove the markers. Next, 
we'll film race footage simulating real 
conditions. Could you please ask the 
collaborators to get ready?
choice_data_list:
Everyone, please take your starting 
positions!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
—Regarding Epiphaneia-san's running, first 
and foremost, her instantaneous power is 
incredible. The viscoelasticity of her 
muscle tendons must be extraordinarily 
high.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Thanks! Guess that just proves my physical 
abilities are incredible too!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
What concerns me is, as expected, your 
movement during the race. Do you see how 
unsteady your footwork is? The sway in 
your upper body is also at a level we 
cannot ignore.
choice_data_list: Why does it get so messy?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Please look at this data. It shows where 
and how Epiphaneia-san is directing her 
power during the race.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, it's heading out in all kinds of big 
ways! ...Wait, huh!?

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
That's right. Like this, the force is 
dispersed, making it impossible to trigger 
an effective burst of power.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
In order to demonstrate your abilities to 
the fullest, you must first create a flow 
that concentrates your power into a single 
point.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
And there is the "strength" of 
Epiphaneia-san that I want to ride that 
momentum with.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
In Epiphaneia-san's running form, there is 
a strong sense of forward drive— a sheer 
determination to push ahead.
choice_data_list: That's Epi's fighting spirit... isn't it

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Yes. Fighting spirit is also something 
that can be converted into strength.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
If I can consciously control the flow of 
power and channel my fighting spirit into 
it—
choice_data_list:
You can unleash your fighting spirit at 
the perfect moment!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"To do that... I have to stay conscious 
and keep every part of myself under 
control—"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Huh? Then what about the voice of destiny?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
I gotta keep that under control too. 
Should I really just ignore it after all?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The voice will affirm her choices. If she 
can run in her best rhythm and choose 
where to unleash her explosive burst... it 
will surely give her the push she needs.
choice_data_list:
If anything, cheering voices are the 
greatest boost you can get!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Right, right?! After all, voices are truly 
wonderful things!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text: ...Hehe.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
“—Well then, I shall take my leave. 
Please, do make good use of the data.”
choice_data_list: Thank you so much for your time!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Thank you very much!!

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
Not at all. Both of them are such earnest, 
upfront people... It was truly a pleasure 
working with them.

text_block_list.name: Teacher
text_block_list.text:
"I'm sure the two of you can overcome this 
challenge. Best of luck, okay?"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
So, Trainer! What kind of training are we 
actually gonna do!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
To master how to use her body, she'll also 
need the technique to control it with 
precision. Which means what we need is—
*Sigh*... So hot... Time to cool off...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Her name is Win Variation. An Umamusume 
from the same generation as the "Tyrant" 
Orfevre, currently recovering from an 
injury from what I hear.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And right now, what she is dancing is— 
ballet.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Incredible...! It's so powerful, yet so 
fluid...!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Ballet is often thought of as purely 
elegant, but in truth, it requires 
tremendous muscular strength. That 
strength must be controlled down to the 
millimeter and expressed all the way to 
the fingertips.

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: ! I see, got it!!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Shion!! Teach me ballet!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Whoa!? ...Huh, wh-what is it?! What, what?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"I absolutely need your help! —It has to 
be you!"

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
"Please, won't you give me some time! No, 
you definitely should give it to me!!"

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Ye- WHAAAAAT?!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: Huh, wh... what...?

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text:
Well then, I'm counting on you! Teacher 
Shion!!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text: ...I'm such a pushover.
choice_data_list: That's a huge help, thank you!

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
...Well, I'm injured right now, so I 
couldn't really move around anyway...

text_block_list.name: Win Variation
text_block_list.text:
Alright, I've made up my mind! If I'm 
doing this, I'm going all out, no holding 
back!

text_block_list.name: Epiphaneia
text_block_list.text: Aaaagh!!!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, alongside our usual training, Win 
Variation began teaching us ballet 
movements.
